# knobs — Project-Local Agent Guidance

Project-local conventions for knobs, layered on top of the shared standards in `.standards/governance/`. The shared
standards win on anything they specify; this file covers what they leave to knobs.

## Workspace shape

- One repository, five implementations of one engine, one version (the release tag): Go at the root (module
  `github.com/keelcore/knobs`), `rust/`, `ts/`, `python/`, `c/`.
- `spec/` is the contract: test schemas (`spec/schema/`), the `x-knobs-*` vocabulary (`spec/meta/`) and the
  conformance cases (`spec/cases/`). knobs holds test schemas only; applications own their schemas.
- `tests/conformance.bats` runs every case against each implementation's `knobs-conform` harness (`KNOBS_IMPL`).

## Duties

- **TDD:** a conformance case and unit tests first, shown failing, then the implementation.
- **All languages:** a behavior lands with its case passing in every implementation.
- **Coverage:** per-file coverage never decreases in any language (`make test-coverage`,
  `make check-coverage-regression`); new files reach 95%.
- **Publishers and language tooling** for Rust, TypeScript, Python and C/C++ are owned by knobs, never by
  `.standards`.

## Python boundary

Python sources live in `python/` and run only inside `containers/pypi`, through `scripts/dev/run.sh`. No host script,
hook or host BATS run invokes a Python interpreter; the Python conformance run executes inside `containers/pypi`.

## Plans

`docs/plans/` (gitignored) holds the working plan, `docs/plans/knobs-repo.md`.
